cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both the Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify theme preferences existence under corrupted configuration state
cases.description: Attempt to access theme preferences when configuration files are missing to ensure system behavior handles missing Classic or Modern themes gracefully.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display layout
cases.description: Navigate to theme preferences and select the Classic theme to verify that its layout structure and components render correctly.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Display
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is displayed correctly matching the theme definitions.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View Menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is available and correctly listed.

cases.title: Verify Modern item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The test cases are generally well-aligned with the requirements. However, case G-002 introduces an out-of-scope negative scenario (corrupted configuration state) that is not specified in the requirements. Please remove or revise case G-002 to align strictly with the stated requirements.
confirmed_blockers: Test case G-002 tests an unspecified corrupted configuration state which is not grounded in the requirements.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario verifies both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences. Edge/abnormal scenarios involve missing theme definitions or corrupted preferences. For R-176: Normal scenario verifies Classic theme display, but is currently untestable due to the missing reference image. For R-177: Normal scenario verifies Modern theme display, but is currently untestable due to the missing reference image. For R-178: Normal scenario verifies 'Theme Preferences' is present under View menu. For R-179: Normal scenario verifies 'Get New Themes' is present under View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario verifies 'Classic' item is present under View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario verifies 'Modern' item is present under View menu.
